statement: Readiness-planning memo freshness is expressed as a stored, comparable version key instead of a live publication probe acting as a side-condition veto: the memo stores a frozen version key of the floored source generation plus a rendered publication (epoch,status) component with named markers for probe-unavailable and absent, and both the CL-033 projection memo and the CL-034 merge memo compare that one key, cheap component first, preserving the removed veto's short-circuit order so publication reads per call are unchanged. Key inequality agrees with the removed veto over every ordered pair of publication states and is never weaker, proved by an in-witness oracle that restores the veto verbatim. This Quest makes NO rate-reduction claim: on a production-composition reproduction that matches the live seed within three percent, the veto was measured inert under the evidenced formation shape of GCP run 2026-08-30T17-32-03 (0 fires in 3000 probes; the seed's 49 publication samples were all PUBLISHED across epochs 1 and 2) and heavy planning builds are identical before and after (5180 of 5180, 344.8 per second). Its value is structural and protective: freshness moves into the versioned token the sealed churn-liveness constraint already requires, and the publication-churn shape that measures 2420 builds per second no longer defeats the memo through an unregistered live veto. The floored generation, stale grace, macrotask drain, maxItemsPerDrain and the identity observable are unchanged.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Readiness-planning memo freshness is expressed only as a stored, comparable version key; no live probe may act as a side-condition veto after the key comparison.

Over every ordered pair of publication states, key inequality agrees with the removed (epoch,status) veto and is never weaker; proved by an in-witness oracle that restores the removed veto verbatim, not by inspection.

The floored planning generation (250 ms), the 15 s stale grace, the macrotask drain and maxItemsPerDrain 1 are unchanged; measured heavy planning builds and publication winner reads must not exceed the pre-change values for the sealed churn sequence. This Quest makes no rate-reduction claim: the veto was measured inert under the evidenced formation shape (0 of 3000 probes).
Source scope is the readiness-planning snapshot owner and its memo key derivation; no cross-owner priority edge, no scheduler change, no second ACTIVE or READY authority.
A key-forced miss still mints a fresh projection identity; the projection-planning-identity-memoization observable is not relaxed inside this Quest.
Any builds-per-second claim comes from the production-composition reproduction that matches the live seed within three percent, never from a projection.
